comingLast.roast: 20 off 28 - some days the shots just are not enough
at 1.2 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
on 17 at 1.4 - his playing partners are witnesses now, not opponents
needs 3 from 5 - his playing group has started the commentary
escape requires 3 over the last 5 - his mates have started filming
he needs 2 points and a small miracle - the bar has odds on both
still swinging on 20 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
1 point from 4 holes - entirely gettable, famously not got
in on a 2-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
2 points of insurance at 1.3 a hole - premium unpaid
